description:
When Akizuki Sora confesses his feelings to Fuwa Miya, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Suzukaze Asahi, the president of the mysterious "Clinical Trials Club." When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated...?
Source: Yen Press

titles.title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
